utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Thanks for having me over. Let us look at the inspection photos together.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: The hail came through Tuesday. We found shingle pieces by the driveway.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: There is bruising on the south slope and some lifted flashing by the chimney.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: The insurance adjuster was here yesterday and left this report.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: We will replace the decking where needed and use 25-year architectural shingles. Cleanup and the magnetic nail sweep are included.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: The other company offered the same shingles for less.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: I think our work is better. I could ask about matching their number.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Do you have reviews from homeowners near us?

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: We have been doing this a long time. You will be fine.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: I appreciate you walking me through the photos.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: I will put the full scope and the material list in writing for you.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: I am going to hold off on signing anything.
